# Drawing, colors and output

Chart objects, color constants and text output. A backtest has no chart, so PowerBridge accepts these calls but most have no visible effect; object-creating calls still return an ID.

[Back to the keyword reference index](README.md)

### alertenabled

| Kind | Returns | Arguments | Argument types | Evidence | On MC compile list | Run status |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| builtin | bool | none (used as a value) | not established | capture (strategy-level) | yes | runs |

True when alerts are switched on for the study. PowerBridge backtests run with alerts off, so it is false.

### Arw_New

| Kind | Returns | Arguments | Argument types | Evidence | On MC compile list | Run status |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| builtin | numeric | 4 | any, any, any, any | PowerBridge test (`tests/real_world/test_comprehensive.py`) | yes | runs |

Places an arrow at a date, time and price; the fourth argument is a true/false direction flag. Returns the arrow's ID.

```easylanguage
Vars: ID(0);
If Close > Close[1] Then ID = Arw_New(Date, Time, Low, false);
```

### Arw_New_s

| Kind | Returns | Arguments | Argument types | Evidence | On MC compile list | Run status |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| builtin | numeric | 4 | any, any, any, any | unverified | yes | runs |

Like `Arw_New`, with the time given as HHMMSS.

### Commentary

| Kind | Returns | Arguments | Argument types | Evidence | On MC compile list | Run status |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| builtin | none / not established | at least 1 | not established | PowerBridge test (`tests/generated/test_commentary.py`) | no | runs |

Writes text to the per-bar commentary window. Each argument is turned into text and the pieces are joined. A #BeginCmtry block is not executed: PowerBridge has no commentary-on mode. The text does not change trades.

```easylanguage
Commentary("bar " + NumToStr(CurrentBar, 0));
```

### CommentaryCL

| Kind | Returns | Arguments | Argument types | Evidence | On MC compile list | Run status |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| builtin | none / not established | at least 1 | not established | PowerBridge test (`tests/test_commentary.py`) | no | runs |

Like Commentary, but the text starts on a new line. Each argument is turned into text and the pieces are joined. The text does not change trades.

```easylanguage
CommentaryCL("a", "b");
```

### TL_GetValue

| Kind | Returns | Arguments | Argument types | Evidence | On MC compile list | Run status |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| builtin | numeric | 3 | any, any, any | PowerBridge test (`tests/test_drawing_dump.py`) | no | transpiles; the run stops (not implemented in the runtime) |

Price of a trend line at a date and time. That interpolation is not measured against MultiCharts, so a run that reaches it stops with an error instead of returning 0.

```easylanguage
Vars: id(0);
id = TL_New(Date, Time, Low, Date, Time, High);
If Close > TL_GetValue(id, Date, Time) Then Buy next bar at market;
```

### TL_New

| Kind | Returns | Arguments | Argument types | Evidence | On MC compile list | Run status |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| builtin | numeric | 6 | any, any, any, any, any, any | PowerBridge test (`tests/generated/test_drawing_functions.py`) | yes | runs |

Draws a trend line between two points, each given as date, time (HHMM) and price, and returns the new line's ID.

```easylanguage
Vars: ID(0);
If CurrentBar = 10 Then ID = TL_New(Date[5], Time[5], Low[5], Date, Time, Low);
```
